description: This file defines session management classes and interfaces for Flask, including session mixins, cookie-based session classes, and the default session interface implementation using itsdangerous for signed cookies.

classes.name: SessionMixin
classes.description: Provides a dictionary-like interface with session attributes, including properties for 'permanent', 'new', 'modified', and 'accessed'.

classes.name: SecureCookieSession
classes.description: A session class based on signed cookies, extending CallbackDict and SessionMixin, tracking modifications and access.

classes.name: NullSession
classes.description: A special session class used when sessions are unavailable, raising errors on modification attempts.

classes.name: SessionInterface
classes.description: Defines the interface for session handling in Flask, including methods for opening and saving sessions, and configuration helpers.

classes.name: SecureCookieSessionInterface
classes.description: Default implementation of SessionInterface that stores sessions in signed cookies using itsdangerous.

methods.name: make_null_session
methods.description: Creates a null session object when session support cannot be loaded.

methods.name: is_null_session
methods.description: Checks if a given session object is a null session.

methods.name: get_cookie_name
methods.description: Returns the name of the session cookie.

methods.name: get_cookie_domain
methods.description: Returns the domain attribute for the session cookie.

methods.name: get_cookie_path
methods.description: Returns the path attribute for the session cookie.

methods.name: get_cookie_httponly
methods.description: Returns whether the cookie should be HttpOnly.

methods.name: get_cookie_secure
methods.description: Returns whether the cookie should be secure.

methods.name: get_cookie_samesite
methods.description: Returns the SameSite attribute for the cookie.

methods.name: get_cookie_partitioned
methods.description: Returns whether the cookie should be partitioned.

methods.name: get_expiration_time
methods.description: Calculates expiration time for a session based on permanence.

methods.name: should_set_cookie
methods.description: Determines if a Set-Cookie header should be sent based on session state.

methods.name: open_session
methods.description: Abstract method to open a session from a request.

methods.name: save_session
methods.description: Abstract method to save a session into a response.

methods.name: get_signing_serializer
methods.description: Creates a serializer for signing session data with itsdangerous.

methods.name: get_signing_serializer
methods.description: Creates a serializer for signing session data with itsdangerous.
